diagnosis: The route handler fetches and streams invoice documents by ID directly from storage without asserting that the retrieved invoice belongs to the caller's organization. Any authenticated company employee can download sensitive invoice records, tax filings, and pricing contracts of competitor tenants by supplying arbitrary invoice UUIDs.
